Questions

Good to know

How much does it cost?

Couches from R200 (1 seater), mattresses from R200 (single), carpets from R150 and car seats from R350. Transport charges may apply based on location. Use Get a quote to see your price.

Do I need to bring my items to you?

No. We come to you, wherever you are.

How long until it’s dry?

About 6 hours.

What if I’m not happy?

We have a money-back guarantee.

Where are you based?

We’re at 7 Berg Street, Rustenburg, and we come to you.

How do I book?

Tap the WhatsApp button, call 079 216 3289, or use the quote form. We’ll reply with a price and a time.

Please read

Terms of service

  1. Cleaning service total fee is payable immediately on arrival, before commencement of work.
  2. EFT payment has to be immediate.
  3. In case of power cut, generator use charge of R50 will apply. Otherwise, team will not wait longer than 20 mins for power restoration. Thus the work will be terminated and no refunds.
  4. No responsibility will be taken if fabric is broken due to weakness of the material.
  5. Minimum of 6 hours is required for drying after washing, during which contact must be avoided.
  6. A picture of the furniture will be taken before and after cleaning to show the difference made by the cleaning process. Please note that some discolorations on the fabric are not removable by washing or can be caused by seepage from underlays. Such instances cannot be covered by the money back guarantee.

Transport charges may apply based on location.
